notes: The prompt says obby and tower in one sentence, so Obby & Platformer on course-tower, which routes the genre P6 plus P2 for platforms stacked above each other. Kept the Tower Obby preset and added obstacle-jump for plain gaps and obstacle-moving for the slippery sliding butter surfaces that an all-butter tower implies. With no user to interview I left checkpoint-respawn out, because the answers ask for a short one-sitting climb and the genre treats checkpoints as near-universal but skippable on very short courses, and I read the summit as the winner-zone payoff since the answers rule out a timer or leaderboard. Butter is theming for the image pass rather than a hazard, so nothing contact-lethal was emitted.
